chapters.chorus2: A token is a chunk of text (again)

description:
Ask an AI how many r's are in strawberry and it might say 2. It never saw the letters: before it reads, your words are cut into chunks called tokens, and every chunk is swapped for a number. "strawberry" (with a space in front) is one chunk, number 73700. There are no r's in 73700.

Real numbers, all on screen: Llama 3.1's tokenizer splits the question into 8 tokens (4438 1690 436 596 527 304 73700 30) out of a vocabulary of 128,256. Asked 100 times, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct said 2 in 67 answers. With the letters spaced out (s t r a w b e r r y, every letter its own token) it said 3 in 90 of 100. The chunks you see being built are a real byte-pair encoding run, about 60 lines of Python, trained on this song's own lyrics (first merge: e + r, 64 times).

ML, slowly #2 of 5: one idea per video, sung slowly. Next: #3, Meaning Is a Direction.

{chapters}

AI disclosure: the song (music and vocals) is AI-generated with ACE-Step 1.5; lyrics, data runs, word alignment and every scene (three.js, rendered frame by frame) were made with Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5). Renderer forked from mexicat's p(doom) video (MIT).
